## What and why

## Review checklist (Constitution / Definition of Done)
- [ ] Contract first: `packages/contracts` updated before code (Principle V)
- [ ] No ELEVATE code changed; any new ELEVATE use listed in `docs/elevate-usage.md` (Principle I)
- [ ] Scope derived server-side; ownership checked; no patient data (Principle III)
- [ ] Every decision writes a ledger record (Principle IV)
- [ ] Tests written first for business rules; unit/contract green; coverage gate holds (Principle XI)
- [ ] UI: loading/empty/error/offline/denied states, i18n keys (en, hi), axe clean (Principle VIII)
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, format clean; no secrets
